title: Haven origins and decline
description: The atlas gains proposed origins, expansion, losses, and recovery over relative stages.

title: Connections between Havens
description: Routes appear as systems discover one another, then weaken or break. History controls attach to the map.

title: Custodian-to-Charter history and dossiers
description: Eighteen historical stages, selected Haven and microsystem dossiers, fragmented processing, and varied responses to arrivals.

title: Haven traits and possible philosophies
description: Historical profiles for twelve Havens, with partial system samples and qualified philosophy affinities.

title: At the Height of the Havens
description: Five proposed stories: The Answer That Arrived Sideways; The Interval Before the Reply; The Error in the Perfect Copy; The Room That Waited Too Long; The Seventeenth Place. Twenty chapters with plans, critiques, and three prose passes.

title: Recently added and clearer Haven access
description: Searchable creation log, personal additions, and direct Haven stories links in the library and navigation.
